motion.name: route-traveller
motion.purpose: One packet dot follows the current route.

motion.name: playback-cadence
motion.purpose: Autoplay step interval, stopping at review gates and chapter ends.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Suppress CSS transitions and travelling-dot animation.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Tutorial action with source hover, focus and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;min-height:40px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;transition:background .16s ease,color .16s ease;background:var(--accent, #14665c);color:var(--accent-text, #fff);border:1px solid transparent}.ds-button-primary:hover{filter:brightness(.93)}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #267bc5);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Outlined button
components.description: Tutorial action with source hover, focus and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-button-outlined{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;min-height:40px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;transition:background .16s ease,color .16s ease;background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--ink, #192b34);border:1px solid var(--line, #ced9dd)}.ds-button-outlined:hover{background:var(--soft, #eaf0f2)}.ds-button-outlined:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #267bc5);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button-outlined:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:default}.ds-button-outlined[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent, #14665c);color:var(--accent-text, #fff);border-color:var(--accent, #14665c)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-outlined{transition:none}}

components.name: Quiet button
components.description: Tutorial action with source hover, focus and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;min-height:40px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;transition:background .16s ease,color .16s ease;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #192b34);border:1px solid transparent}.ds-button-quiet:hover{background:var(--soft, #eaf0f2)}.ds-button-quiet:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #267bc5);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button-quiet:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-quiet{transition:none}}

components.name: Terminal Run button
components.description: Contextual action for the illustrated command parser.

components.name: Command field
components.description: Dark inset command entry with monospace text.
components.html: $
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#0f1b23;border:1px solid var(--terminal-line, #3b4a54);border-radius:5px;min-height:40px;padding:3px 4px 3px 10px}.ds-prompt{color:var(--terminal-muted, #a8bac5);font:13px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace}.ds-field input{width:100%;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--terminal-text, #e2eaf0);padding:6px 0;font:12px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace;caret-color:#b7deff}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:var(--terminal-muted, #a8bac5)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #267bc5);outline-offset:1px}

components.name: Chapter navigation
components.description: Meaningful numbered sequence and explicit current chapter.
components.html: <nav class="ds-chapters" aria-label="Walkthrough chapters"><button class="ds-chapter" aria-current="step">1 Connect</button><button class="ds-chapter">2 Message</button><button class="ds-chapter">3 Human approval</button><button class="ds-chapter">4 Catch up</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-chapters{display:flex;gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #ced9dd);padding-bottom:12px}.ds-chapter{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:10px 16px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted, #56666e);font-weight:600;font-size:13px}.ds-chapter:hover{background:var(--soft, #eaf0f2);color:var(--ink, #192b34)}.ds-chapter[aria-current="step"]{background:var(--ink, #192b34);color:var(--bg, #f4f7f8)}.ds-chapter:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #267bc5);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:780px){.ds-chapters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px;padding-bottom:10px}.ds-chapter{white-space:nowrap;padding:9px 10px;font-size:12px;gap:6px}}

components.name: Local actor node
components.description: Alice agent node with inspection and current-route states; Bob uses Bob colors.
components.css: .ds-node{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;--person:var(--alice, #4354a2);--person-soft:var(--alice-soft, #edf0fc);background:var(--surface, #fff);border:1px solid var(--line, #ced9dd);border-radius:6px;min-height:70px;padding:7px 3px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;color:var(--ink, #192b34);transition:background .16s ease,border-color .16s ease}.ds-node svg{width:21px;height:21px;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;color:var(--muted, #56666e);margin-bottom:3px}.ds-node strong{font-size:12px;font-weight:650}.ds-node small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted, #56666e);line-height:1.4;text-align:center}.ds-node:hover,.ds-node[data-selected="true"]{background:var(--person-soft);border-color:var(--person)}.ds-node[data-active="true"]{background:var(--person-soft);border-color:var(--person);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--person)}.ds-node[data-active="true"] svg,.ds-node[data-active="true"] strong{color:var(--person)}.ds-node:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #267bc5);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-node{transition:none}}

components.name: Shared service
components.description: Neutral infrastructure with active and offline states.
components.css: .ds-service{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-height:124px;border:1px solid var(--line, #ced9dd);border-radius:9px;background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--ink, #192b34);padding:15px 9px}.ds-service svg{width:24px;height:24px;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;margin-bottom:5px}.ds-service strong{font-size:14px;font-weight:650}.ds-service small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted, #56666e)}.ds-state{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted, #56666e);margin-top:6px;line-height:1.4;min-height:28px}.ds-service:hover,.ds-service[data-selected="true"]{background:var(--soft, #eaf0f2);border-color:var(--ink, #192b34)}.ds-service[data-active="true"]{background:var(--bob-soft, #e6f4ef);border-color:var(--accent, #14665c);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #14665c)}.ds-service[data-offline="true"]{border-style:dashed;border-color:var(--warning, #8a540d);background:var(--warning-soft, #fff2db)}.ds-service[data-offline="true"] .ds-state{color:var(--warning, #8a540d)}.ds-service:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #267bc5);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
This record covers only the educational HTML tutorial in tutorial/. It does not set design policy for the protocol, CLI or native macOS signer. It describes the finished source implementation, not browser-computed measurements.

A cool workspace supports dark terminals and named local actors. Restrained app typography, stable actor colors and fine boundaries keep one operation legible at a time. Optional explanations preserve a compact first view. The north star is a descriptive summary of the supplied direction, not a separately selected brand concept.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral workspace with dark terminals.
Persistent indigo Alice and teal Bob identities.
Stable actor geometry with one current route.
Progressive disclosure and synchronized mobile playback.

rules.name: The Actor Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep Alice indigo and Bob teal, with names and positions providing redundant identity cues.

rules.name: The Literal Code Rule
rules.body: Reserve monospace for commands, terminal records and sealed packet labels.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal surfaces for diagram structure; reserve the ambient shadow for the floating inspector.

dos: Do preserve actor names, positions and colors across steps.
Do synchronize narration, packet state and playback controls.
Do retain optional Why text and object inspection.
Do use authored inline SVG for the diagram icon system.
Do retain theme-aware keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't extend this tutorial record into protocol, CLI or native signer design policy.
Don't use color alone for identity or state.
Don't imply illustrative commands execute real operations.
Don't treat review screenshots as shipped imagery.
